connect.title: Connect AI
connect.heading: AI needs a key to help with words and pictures
connect.lead: A key is like your own password for using AI. Keys from Google Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI all work, and the app can tell which one you have. The key is saved only on this device.
connect.step1.title: Open the key page
connect.step1.body: Press the AI company you want to use. A new window opens. If you are not sure, choose Google Gemini.
connect.step2.title: Make a key and copy it
connect.step2.body: Press the button that says Create and key, then copy the long text that appears.
connect.step2.alt: Picture: press a button, a long text appears, and you copy it
connect.step3.title: Paste it here
connect.step3.body: Paste it in the box below and press [Check connection].
connect.step3.alt: Picture: pasting the copied text into a box
connect.key_placeholder: Paste the key you copied here
connect.bad_key: That key doesn't match. Shall we copy it again?
connect.browser_blocked: The key looks right, but the Claude organization that made it has browser use turned off in its settings. Ask the person who manages the organization to turn it on, or put in a different key.
connect.network: The internet seems to be off. Check your connection and press [Check connection] again.
connect.failed: We can't check right now. Press [Check connection] again in a little while.
connect.empty: The key box is empty. Paste the key you copied into the box.
connect.no_image: Claude does not draw pictures. Upload your own pictures, or add a separate picture key (Google Gemini or OpenAI) under the detailed settings.
connect.image_key_claude: A Claude key cannot make pictures. Please enter a Google Gemini or OpenAI key.
connect.details: More settings (separate key for pictures, change the kind of AI)
connect.image_key_label: Key for pictures (leave empty to use the key above)
connect.image_key_placeholder: Paste a key just for pictures, if you have one
connect.kind_hint: Not sure? Leave these as they are.
connect.age_line: Only people 18 or older can get a Google Gemini key, and its terms do not allow connecting it where people under 18 use it. For Claude and OpenAI, the adult or organization that got the key must have the safeguards those companies set before people under 18 use it. (Checked 2026-11-14)
connect.cost_line: Google Gemini has a number of free uses for writing. Claude, OpenAI, and all pictures need a key that is paid for.
connect.shared_line: On a shared device, erase the key when you finish.
connect.clear: Erase the key from this device
connect.cleared: The key was erased from this device.

rights.title: Rights and terms of use
rights.heading: The rights to your book belong to you
rights.statement.ko: 만든 책의 권리는 만든 사람에게 있습니다. 이 도구와 DI Lab은 결과물에 어떤 권리도 주장하지 않습니다.
rights.statement.en: The rights to the book you make belong to you. This tool and DI Lab claim no rights to anything you create.
rights.fonts: The three fonts used in books are under the SIL Open Font License. Books that use them can be printed, shared, and sold.
rights.ai: If any picture was made with AI, the sentence "Some pictures were made with AI" is added automatically to the "Made by" page. Contests and publishers may ask you to disclose AI use, so check their rules first.
rights.provider: Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI state in their terms that they do not claim, or that they assign to you, the rights in AI output. However, Korean copyright law protects only works made by people, so the AI-made parts themselves may not be protected. Parts you edited, chose, or arranged can be protected.
rights.others: To use someone else's pictures, real people, characters, or trademarks, you need permission from the rights holder. Schools and organizations need consent from students and parents before publishing student work. This is not legal advice.
